style: Cozy nature-themed casual mobile puzzle game UI art, warm brown wooden textures, cream beige parchment panels with soft inner shading, small fresh green leaf accents, glossy saturated colors, thick soft dark-brown outlines, cartoon style, clean edges, high quality game asset, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.name: shop_bg
items.prompt: Vertical wall of warm dark-brown wooden planks running top to bottom, lush green leaves peeking in from the four corners, a few small white daisies and smooth grey stones in the bottom corners.

items.name: shop_pack_panel
items.prompt: Wide horizontal rounded-rectangle card, cream beige parchment fill, light golden-brown thick rim with soft bevel, two small green leaf sprigs on the top-left and top-right corners, plain empty interior.

items.name: shop_bt_buy
items.prompt: Wide glossy rounded-rectangle green button, bright lime-green top with a white glossy highlight, darker green bottom lip for a 3D pressed look, thin dark-green outline, empty face with no symbol.

items.name: shop_icon_undo
items.prompt: Small rounded square tile in light cream with a soft lavender-grey border, containing a bright glossy blue circular undo arrow in the upper part, leave the bottom quarter of the tile empty.

items.name: shop_icon_magic_wand
items.prompt: Small rounded square tile in light cream with a soft lavender-grey border, containing a glossy golden magic wand topped with a yellow star and tiny sparkles in the upper part, leave the bottom quarter of the tile empty.

items.name: shop_icon_shuffle
items.prompt: Small rounded square tile in light cream with a soft lavender-grey border, containing two glossy bright green crossing shuffle arrows in the upper part, leave the bottom quarter of the tile empty.

items.name: shop_coin_stack_large
items.prompt: Pile of five shiny gold coins, each coin embossed with a cute paw print, three coins stacked and two leaning in front.

items.name: shop_coin_stack_small
items.prompt: Two shiny gold coins slightly overlapping, each embossed with a cute paw print.
